title: 8-Day Cairo & Hurghada Cultural & Beach Tour
metaDescription: Explore Cairo's Pyramids and ancient treasures before relaxing in Hurghada on an 8-day Egypt holiday combining cultural sightseeing and the Red Sea.
breadcrumb: Explore Our Travel Destinations & Multi-Country Tours
summary:
The 8-Day Cairo, Hurghada & Red Sea Tour connects Egypt’s archaeological heartland with several nights on the Red Sea coast. Explore the Pyramids of Giza, Saqqara, Memphis and the Grand Egyptian Museum before making the overland journey from Cairo to Hurghada. The change of setting is substantial: ancient sites and guided visits give way to coastal time, with opportunities for swimming, relaxing by the sea or choosing optional activities in Hurghada.
Travel between Cairo and Hurghada is arranged by road, so no domestic flight is needed. The package covers selected 4-star hotels with breakfast, English-speaking local guides, transfers, entrance fees and scheduled sightseeing.

itinerary.title: Arrival in Cairo
itinerary.text:
Arrival at Cairo International Airport. Meet and transfer to your hotel in Cairo.
Hotel check-in after 14:00. The remainder of the day is at leisure. Overnight in Cairo.

itinerary.title: Tour to Giza and Memphis
itinerary.text: Breakfast at the hotel. Visit Memphis, the ancient capital of Egypt, and see the colossal statue of Ramesses II. Continue to Saqqara to visit the famous Step Pyramid of Djoser. Later, explore the Pyramids of Giza built for Cheops, Chephren, and Mycerinus, along with the mysterious Great Sphinx of Giza. Transfer back to the hotel. Overnight in Cairo.

itinerary.title: Cairo to Hurghada *by bus
itinerary.text: Breakfast at the hotel, followed by check-out and transfer to the SuperJet Bus Station for your bus journey to Hurghada (approximately 7–8 hours drive). Optional domestic flight is available at extra cost. Upon arrival, transfer to your hotel. Overnight in Hurghada.

itinerary.title: Day at Leisure in Hurghada
itinerary.text: Breakfast at the hotel. Enjoy a free day at leisure in Hurghada. Relax on the sandy beaches, swim in the crystal-clear waters of the Red Sea, or join optional snorkeling and diving excursions to discover colorful coral reefs and marine life. Additional optional water sports and boat trips are also available. Overnight in Hurghada.

itinerary.title: Day at Leisure in Hurghada
itinerary.text: Breakfast at the hotel. Enjoy a free day at leisure in Hurghada. Relax on the beaches, explore the colorful coral reefs of the Red Sea, or join optional water activities and boat excursions. Overnight in Hurghada.

itinerary.title: Day at Leisure in Hurghada
itinerary.text: Breakfast at the hotel. Enjoy a free day at leisure in Hurghada. Spend the day relaxing by the pool or beach, exploring the marina and local cafés, or joining optional desert safari and quad bike excursions. Optional snorkeling and diving trips in the Red Sea are also available. Overnight in Hurghada.

itinerary.title: Hurghada to Cairo *by bus
itinerary.text: Breakfast at the hotel, followed by check-out and transfer to the SuperJet Bus Station for your bus journey to Cairo (approximately 7–8 hours drive). Optional domestic flight is available at extra cost. Upon arrival, transfer to your hotel. Overnight in Cairo.

itinerary.title: Departure from Cairo
itinerary.text:
After breakfast, check out from the hotel before 12:00 pm.
Transfer to Cairo Airport according to your flight departure time.

faqs.q: What destinations are included in the 8-Day Egypt Relaxing Resort Getaway Package?
faqs.a: The 8-Day Egypt Relaxing Resort Getaway Package covers Cairo and Hurghada. You will discover Egypt's ancient wonders in Cairo, including the Pyramids of Giza and the Great Sphinx, before relaxing on the beautiful Red Sea coast in Hurghada, known for its beaches, resorts, and crystal-clear waters. The tour runs for 7 nights and 8 days.

faqs.q: How much does the 8-Day Egypt Relaxing Resort Getaway Package cost?
faqs.a: The tour starts from €1,295 per person for the 2026 season. The price includes hotel accommodation, guided sightseeing tours, selected meals, transfers, and transportation according to the itinerary. Final pricing may vary depending on travel dates and hotel category.

faqs.q: Are domestic or international flights included in the package?
faqs.a: No, neither domestic flights nor international flights are included in this package. Travelers are responsible for arranging their own flights to and from Egypt. Ground transportation between Cairo and Hurghada is included according to the itinerary.

faqs.q: What kind of accommodation does the tour provide?
faqs.a: The package includes accommodation at carefully selected hotels in Cairo and a beach resort in Hurghada. Daily breakfast is included, and additional meal plans may be available depending on the hotel or resort selected.

faqs.q: Does the 8-day Egypt resort package include a guide?
faqs.a: Yes, professional English-speaking Egyptologist guides accompany the scheduled sightseeing tours in Cairo. Your guide will provide fascinating insights into Egypt's ancient history and cultural heritage.

faqs.q: Is this tour suitable for first-time visitors to Egypt?
faqs.a: Yes, this tour is ideal for first-time visitors looking to combine Egypt's iconic historical attractions with a relaxing beach vacation. It offers the perfect balance between sightseeing and leisure.

faqs.q: How fit do I need to be for the tour?
faqs.a: The physical difficulty is easy. Visitors should be comfortable walking through archaeological sites and museums in Cairo. Most of the time in Hurghada is dedicated to relaxation and optional activities.

faqs.q: What are the highlights of Cairo and Hurghada?
faqs.a: Cairo is famous for the Pyramids of Giza, the Great Sphinx, and the Egyptian Museum. Hurghada is renowned for its beautiful beaches, luxury resorts, snorkeling, diving opportunities, boat excursions, and vibrant marine life in the Red Sea.

faqs.q: What is the cancellation policy for the 8-Day Egypt Relaxing Resort Getaway Package?
faqs.a: Free cancellation is available up to 30 days before the tour departure date. Cancellations made within 30 days may be subject to fees according to the booking terms and cancellation policy. Travel insurance is recommended for additional flexibility and protection.

faqs.q: Can the 8-Day Egypt Relaxing Resort Getaway Package be customized?
faqs.a: Yes, the package can be customized according to your preferences. You can add extra nights in Cairo or Hurghada, upgrade hotel categories, include optional excursions such as snorkeling or desert safaris, or extend your stay to other destinations in Egypt. Contact Magnificent Travel for a personalized itinerary and quotation.
